description: This file contains utility functions for mapping statuses and strings to specific colors, used for consistent UI coloring in dashboards. It defines 'colorFromString' for deterministic pastel hues, and 'getStatusColor' for mapping known statuses to theme colors or to a deterministic color.

methods.name: colorFromString(key, { saturation = 55, lightness = 55 } = {})
methods.description: Deterministically generates a pastel-like HSL color from an input string, producing distinct hues for different strings while maintaining suitable saturation and lightness for dark backgrounds.

methods.name: getStatusColor(status, oc)
methods.description: Maps a status string to a theme color, with known statuses mapped to specific theme tokens and unknown statuses assigned a deterministic pastel color.
